findings.source_quote: τοῖς παρίᾳ φόβοις καὶ ἐπιθυμίᾳ ἀποδιδούσης τὰς ἰδέας
findings.english_quote: that assigns the forms to the παρίᾳ fears and to desire
findings.issue: Surviving παρίᾳ remains untranslated. Its apparent singular form is not explained as a modifier of plural φόβοις, and no supported contextual meaning or separate syntactic attachment is established. Merely retaining the Greek word does not supply its meaning in English. The draft honestly discloses this limitation, but disclosure cannot resolve missing supported meaning. This is a publication block, unlike the passage’s disclosed ambiguities that have defensible English interpretations. The supplied print verification does not establish that this word is an OCR error.
findings.suggested_revision: Provide lexical and syntactic evidence establishing a defensible rendering of the exact printed παρίᾳ in this clause. If a textual correction is proposed, distinguish it explicitly from the verified supplied reading and document its justification; do not silently substitute another edition’s wording. Until a supported rendering is available, retain the unresolved reading and the publication block. Any revised English requires fresh review.
